channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Wins this period: AbbVie announced a $217M expansion of its Barceloneta plant (about 100 jobs, with up to $45.9M in DDEC incentives), and Amazon opened its first Caribbean delivery station in Dorado. Aman's first Puerto Rico resort at the $2B Esencia development, a $12.7M PAC-TECH expansion, a $54M BlueSky FBO at SJU and Aerostar's $193M BBB+ airport bonds add to the investment pipeline, and Avelo, Frontier and Air Canada are adding about 60,000 winter seats. The main risks are energy and the climate: New Fortress Energy's LNG outage is pushing Genera to diesel (a $90.9M fuel reconciliation and a possible contract termination), the fiscal board is in a creditor fight with PREPA bondholders, and permitting reform slipped to January 2027. Consumer confidence hit a five-year low and the board criticized the handling of economic development funds.
